description: Open a URL headlessly and return its elements with Playwright locators proven unique on the page (role + name first), CSS selectors, visibility, text and console messages. storageState/headers open it signed in; actions click/fill first to reach a state. view 'locators' is the compact map.

actions.description: Steps run after load to reach a state (modal, step 3)

locator.description: Locator or selector, e.g. getByRole('button', { name: 'Next' })

value.description: fill text, press key, select option

maxHtmlChars.description: HTML cap when includeHtml is set (default 20000)

projectRoot.description: Project whose Playwright launches the browser (default: server root)

selector.description: CSS selector: inspect matches instead of the whole DOM

storageState.description: Logged-in session: storageState JSON inside the project, e.g. playwright/.auth/user.json

url.description: Full URL of the page to open (http/https)

view.description: 'locators': compact map of interactive elements (cheapest); 'elements' (default): DOM inventory

name: inspect-page
title: Inspect live page DOM
